title: Quote Card Slider
description:
For global requirements and further info, please look into Epic

* simple animation
* no max. cards limit
* for lg breakpoint and above: fixed card with:

    ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=e9657d98-4a25-4842-8ae3-cd16244a664d&&collection=&height=255&occurrenceKey=null&width=640&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
* user can choose card style for the slider
* user can change card background color
* user can choose star rating variant
* user can choose navigation style (bullets or numbers)
* Height of each card adjusts to the height of the highest card

    * There are no max. characters, but we recommend approx. 200 characters.
    

The following storybook stories have been created:

* Slider with slides (default, left-aligned with avatar and logo) and navigation-buttons
* Slider with slides (default, center-aligned with stars and avatar) and scrollbar-buttons
* Slider with slides (dark-background, left-aligned with stars and avatar and logo) and scrollbar-buttons
* Slider with slides (bright-background, left-aligned with stars and avatar and logo) and scrollbar-buttons
* Slider with slides (outline, left-aligned with stars and avatar and logo) and scrollbar-buttons
* Slider with slides (haptic, left-aligned with stars and avatar and logo) and scrollbar-buttons

summary: A carousel slider displaying multiple Quote Cards with animated transitions, customizable navigation, and consistent card height adjustment.
features: Unlimited slides with smooth animated transitions
Two navigation styles: scrollbar buttons or navigation buttons
Unified card styling across slides (default, dark, bright, outline, haptic)
Automatic height equalization to match the tallest card
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Quote Card Slider enables website visitors to browse through multiple customer testimonials in an engaging carousel format. By presenting diverse experiences from different customers, it builds trust and helps potential customers make informed decisions.

## Use Cases

- Display a collection of customer reviews on landing pages with easy navigation between testimonials
- Showcase testimonials from different industries or customer segments in a compact space
- Present star-rated reviews in a visually consistent carousel format
- Feature customer feedback prominently on homepage or product pages

## Design Rationale

The slider format maximizes the impact of social proof by allowing multiple testimonials to occupy the same visual space while maintaining engagement through user-controlled navigation. The automatic height equalization ensures visual consistency when testimonials vary in length. Supporting multiple card styles allows the component to adapt to different page contexts and brand requirements.
